title: City Ordinances: Solicitation, Alcohol Rules
summary:
*   Held a special executive session to receive confidential legal advice on various city matters.
*   Discussed the city's "Charitable Solicitations" ordinance with legal counsel.
*   Reviewed the "Alcohol Consumption Ordinance" with the city's legal team.
*   No final decisions, actions, or votes were taken during this session on any topic.
